_BIRTH_EXPAND_LAYERS = tuple(range(1, 11))
_BIRTH_EXPAND_STATS = dict(calls=0, added=0)

def _birth_expand_select(score, floor, layer):
    if layer not in _BIRTH_EXPAND_LAYERS:
        return select(score, floor)
    keep = []
    ge = score >= floor
    nz = fnp.nonzero(ge)
    keep.append((ge, nz))
    original = min(len(score), (int(nz[0].shape[0]) + 31) // 32 * 32)
    count = min(len(score), original + 32)
    neg = -score
    order = fnp.argsort(neg, kind='stable')
    keep.append((neg, order))
    indices = order[:count]
    mask = fnp.zeros(len(score), dtype=fnp.bool_)
    fnp.put(mask, indices, True)
    _BIRTH_EXPAND_STATS['calls'] += 1
    _BIRTH_EXPAND_STATS['added'] += count - original
    return indices, mask
